_about: Scenarios for the NekoPower orchestrator: where a newly dispatched sentence goes.

worlds: what is there already. Projects (name, what they are for, whether the directory is a git repository, the session id of the leader or null), and task agents (members of a project when 'project' is set, else loose ones). 'idle_hours' is how long ago the agent's last commission ended; 'done' are its latest commissions, newest first, each with how it was filed when it came ('new', 'recurrence' or 'follow_up').

cases: one sentence each ('dispatch' is what she handed over, 'user' the user's own words). 'truth' names the matter it belongs to ('agent:<id>', 'project:<name>' or null) and how it relates to it. 'expect' is where it goes with the default settings; 'expect_family_at_2', where given, is where it would go if two occurrences already made a family.

Actions: continue (an agent that is there goes on with it), summon_in_project (a new agent in a project), summon_stray (a new loose agent), to_leader (the leader of a project, derived when the project is in a git repository and has none), form_family (loose agents that did the same thing before become a project; 'agent' is the member that takes this one, null for a new one).
